description: This PHP source file defines a class Upgrade11 within the Opencart installation upgrade controller hierarchy. The class contains a method 'index' that performs a series of database schema updates and data migrations related to upgrade process 11 for Opencart, including data serialization fixes, schema modifications, data merging, and cleanup tasks. It is part of the upgrade system for a specific version update.

classes.name: Upgrade11
classes.description: A controller class responsible for executing database and data migrations during upgrade to version 11 in Opencart.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Performs a series of database updates and data transformations to upgrade the system to version 11, including fixing serialized data, updating schema, merging customer and affiliate data, removing obsolete fields and tables, and preparing the next upgrade step.
